title: Introspection is a conscious higher-order thought

statements.text: Introspection is the attentive, deliberately focused consciousness of a mental state. It occurs when the higher-order thought about the state is itself conscious, which needs a third-order thought. Ordinary consciousness of a state is the second-order thought without the third.

sources.quote: Introspective consciousness is the special case in which that second-order thought is also conscious.
Having a conscious mental state without introspectively focusing on it is having the second-order thought without the third-order thought.
